ms.report:
Milestone 3 Report
Acceptance Criteria
The successful delivery of open-source code for capturing Webhooks related to:
・Payments
・Blocks
・Transactions
・Epoch
・Delegation
・Asset Activity

Evidence of Milestone Completion
The completion of this milestone is demonstrated through the open-source code and documentation available in the respective repositories. The provided resources include the implementation of Webhooks capturing various Cardano-related events and their integration with Kafka for event handling and notification delivery.
Cardano-api
・Repository: Cardano-api
・Description: The main repository containing the Cardano API, which serves as the foundation for the project. The Readme documentation provides detailed instructions on setting up and utilizing the API.

cardano-events
・Repository: cardano-events
・Description: This repository contains the code for listening to Ogmios and writing events to Kafka. It ensures that all significant Cardano events are captured and forwarded to the Kafka message broker for further processing.

cardano-webhooks
・Repository: cardano-webhooks
・Description: This repository focuses on consuming events from Kafka and sending notifications to users. It facilitates the delivery of real-time updates about Cardano events to the relevant stakeholders.

Video Demonstration
・Link: Demo Video

Conclusion
The successful delivery of Milestone 3 is evidenced by the availability of open-source code and comprehensive documentation in the specified repositories. The implemented Webhooks capture essential Cardano events, and the integration with Kafka ensures efficient event processing and notification delivery. This milestone’s completion aligns with the project plan and sets a solid foundation for future developments.
